text: The original test runs subscription on/off and mbox/maildir variants for both IMAP implementations, but its JavaScript branch has weaker depth/subscription assertions. Fixed accepted test_listClosesDB now tests both store types, verifies every level of the four-deep hierarchy and checks all corresponding cached databases are closed. Preserve the discovered-tree and database-lifetime assertions as distinct checks; do not claim the old JavaScript branch proved the same behavior as the native branch. The later discovery/backout sequence is reused context, not fully restudied here. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: The initial deep-discovery test has different native and JavaScript coverage
